explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to plants with multiple OAI classifications and warning letters within three years before the shortage posting

sentences.text: FDA first posted the sodium chloride shortage on 2015-02-17 and as of 2026-10-21 it has been on the list for 140 months.
Multiple registered plants on our product labels have received OAI classifications and warning letters from FDA within three years before the shortage posting.

Baxter Healthcare Corporation plants received OAI classifications on 2012-11-16 (823 days before posting), 2013-01-11 (767 days before), 2013-04-19 (669 days before), 2014-02-11 (371 days before), 2014-03-28 (326 days before), 2015-04-28 (70 days after), 2015-05-01 (73 days after), 2016-02-26 (374 days after), 2016-06-08 (477 days after), and 2016-10-03 (594 days after).
Warning letters were issued to Baxter Healthcare Corporation on 2013-05-31 (627 days before posting), 2014-10-21 (119 days before posting), and 2016-08-25 (555 days after posting).
Hospira, Inc. plants received OAI classifications on 2010-01-19, 2011-06-17, 2011-08-04, 2016-06-08, and 2018-08-15, with warning letters on 2010-04-12 and 2017-02-14.
Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC plants received OAI classifications on 2011-07-08, 2013-01-11, and a warning letter on 2012-02-22 (1091 days before posting).
The rule-based best option is to buy from Ionis Pharmaceuticals, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and operates the IONIS PHARMS INC. plant.

Q-c87ce6.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%sodium%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%sodium%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key
